en.headline: Overhead display left dangling at airport Terminal 2 after cable fault
en.dek: A suspended electronic screen at the newly reopened Terminal 2 dropped several metres on Saturday morning but was caught by its fall-arrest system; no one was hurt.
body: An overhead electronic display at Hong Kong International Airport’s Terminal 2 was left hanging in mid-air after a support cable failed early on Saturday, the Airport Authority said.

The incident occurred at about 8.30am in the departure hall. The marine-themed screen, roughly 1.5 metres square, fell about seven metres from its original height of around 15 metres before its fall-arrest system engaged, leaving it suspended about eight metres above the floor.

Police were alerted and found no immediate danger; firefighters stood by at the scene. No injuries were reported. The authority said it immediately cordoned off the area and a maintenance team further stabilised the installation.

A spokesman said the Airport Authority takes the matter seriously and will conduct a detailed investigation into the cause to further enhance system stability. Terminal 2’s departure facilities reopened on 27 May as part of the airport’s three-runway system expansion.

zh.headline: 機場T2離港大堂顯示屏鋼纜故障半天吊 無人受傷
zh.dek: 今早約8時半，二號客運大樓離港層一塊懸掛電子顯示屏出現故障，防墮系統即時發揮作用，無人受傷，機管局將深入調查。
body: 機場管理局表示，今日早上約8時30分，香港國際機場二號客運大樓離港層一塊懸掛的電子顯示屏出現故障。
該海洋主題顯示屏約1.5米乘1.5米，由原本約15米高處下墜約7米後，防墮系統發揮作用，最終懸停在離地約8米位置。警方接報到場，確認沒有即時危險，消防在場戒備，事件中無人受傷。
機管局即時圍封現場，維修團隊進一步穩定裝置。發言人表示對事件十分關注，將徹底調查成因，以進一步加強安全系統穩定性。
二號客運大樓離港設施於5月27日重開，屬機場三跑道系統擴建的一部分。
